title: Anenji ANJ-4.2KW-24V-WIFI (SMG-II) safe write and readback validation
summary: Authorised safe write/readback cycles on a live Anenji ANJ-4.2KW-24V-WIFI (SMG-II): buzzer mode (register 303, Beeps Off to Beeps On and back), LCD backlight (305, off to on and back) and LCD auto-return (306, off to on and back) were toggled through their Home Assistant select and switch entities. Every write read the new value back from the register, the original value was restored, and the restore was verified. All writes and readbacks succeeded; the same three registers also accepted direct FC16 writes. No battery, charge-current or voltage setpoint was touched.
